_docMalta: ⚑ PLACEHOLDER-draft, and the hardest lines in the era — the spec says so explicitly and hands them to Sérgio to rewrite. THE BREAK (spec §4): December 2016, Act LV, the first national ban in Europe — the one E3 fact the project's KB records as CONFIRMED. It arrives ON THE PHONE, from an UNNAMED PEER MODERATOR IN ANOTHER COUNTRY doing the identical work — deliberately NOT Noa (rev 4 §1: Noa is on the correction list, and if she also brought Malta the era would resolve her, which the canon forbids). She is named only by a first name in a contact row; `Bea` is invented and is her whole existence in the piece. Register: `felt`. Bare — no Lambient badge on this screen (the phone is the one thing in the room she chose; the apparatus does not get a mark on it), no mechanics, no satire, and nothing here is filed to the ledger. The reply field is real, active and blinking; pressing it holds the cursor in an empty field and nothing else happens. There is no keyboard in this piece and there is no reply.
